prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
Four concentric expanding wave-rings radiating outward from a center
dot — symbolic of social resonance.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor on aged parchment, four concentric wave-rings radiating from a central dot, centered on warm vellum cream with ember orange punctuating each arc.

subjects.description: Four bold expanding circular arcs, evenly spaced, radiating outward from a solid center dot; clean nib-pen lines with crisp silhouette readable at icon scale.
Small solid filled circle at the origin point; dense and anchoring, heavier weight than the surrounding arcs.
